page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. This CPU configuration provides 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz, with hyperthreading disabled to ensure one thread per physical core. The instance is provisioned with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, featuring 47,244 GB of local HDD storage. While the mechanical nature of HDD storage limits random input/output operations per second compared to modern solid-state drives, it provides a highly dense storage tier for sequential read and write operations. The instance also delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1.4xlarge lies in its reliance on legacy Intel Xeon architecture and mechanical HDD storage, which lacks the high-speed random access of NVMe SSDs. However, the high storage-to-compute ratio makes this instance cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive local data capacity without the need for high-speed transactional storage. Appropriate workloads include large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems, cold data storage, and sequential log processing.
